quote: In this section, we further discuss extending our framework to more task types. ... These tasks include generative tasks proposed by Weston et al. (2015): 1) Supporting Fact Synthesis: Given a context, generate facts supported by the context about the target entity; 2) Argument Relation Generation: Given a context, generate entities that are in a required relationship with the target entity; 3) Coreference QA: Given a context, answer the question depends on the understanding of coreference.
Same as previous experiential learning studies, our work mainly focuses on classification tasks. We provide further discussion on how to extend our framework to other task types in Appendix F.
